latest.title: A complete rewrite
highlights: Rolls with several parts, such as 2d6+1d4+3, plus keep and drop for highest and lowest.
Results float above the roller's head for players nearby who can see them.
Natural 20s and 1s are called out in chat and coloured above the roller's head.
Rolls are made on the server and sent only to players nearby in the same instance.
ox_lib and a /do command are no longer needed.
